description: Cmdkey is a built-in Windows tool that can cache domain user credentials for use on specific target machines, Attackers can access cached user credentials using cmdkey /list.
investigative_actions: Check the initiator process for additional suspicious activity. Check if the host is a shared host that multiple users' credentials can be extracted from.
name: Cached credentials discovery with cmdkey
